title: The component model is written down before it is built
goal: Component support is about to be built across several sittings. Write one page that says what a component is in Photonz, how you make one, how a copy of it stays linked to the original, what can be changed on a copy, and what the first version deliberately leaves out.
notes: Source material: docs/design/mocks/pages/component-configure-wt.html (the eleven step walkthrough is the whole flow: select the layers you drew, Make component, Add property, expose a toggle as a boolean, expose a control as a variant, bind a fill to a Style, drop an instance, configure it, reset it), components.html (the Library with scopes, drag to place), ui-variants.html (the variant by size matrix and instance props). The mock’s one line definition to build on: a component is a reusable layer tree with configurable properties, and nothing about it is a special editor. Where the app is today: PhotonzDocument holds one flat array of layers (Document.swift), LayerContent has image, text, annotation, zoomCallout, measure and collage cases (Layer.swift:324), there is no group, no library and no component anywhere in Sources. Copy the shape of docs/design/next-measure.md, which has served the measure epic well: numbered sections, a Done when list, and flags named next to the behavior they gate. Styles and tokens belong to the ui-design-systems epic, staged later, so the spec should name the seam and stop there.
acceptance: docs/design/next-components.md exists and covers, in plain language: a group, a main component, an instance, an override, a variant, where the Library lives, every menu item and key, and the flag each slice ships behind
It has a Done when section listing the slices in build order, each small enough for one working session
It states whether a child layer’s position is stored against its parent or against the whole picture, and why
It says what the first version does not do, so later work is not judged against a promise nobody made
It records where it disagrees with the mock pages and the reason
